entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling about the VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought a few weeks ago. I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it works fine. It was a bit of an impulse buy, to be honest. I've found I just don't use it. I've basically just changed my mind about needing it.
I see. I appreciate the honesty. Let me just pull up your order details. Can you confirm the email address you used for the purchase?
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered on December 15th, so about 25 days ago.

Right. I know I'm probably outside the standard window. I was hoping maybe we could work something out? I don't even need a full refund, perhaps a 50% store credit or a discount code for a future purchase? I was worried I'd have to look for a resale marketplace otherwise.

Let me just check the policy for that item for you. One moment... Okay, I've got it. Our knowledge base shows that for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, you have 90 days from the date of delivery to make a return.
Wait, 90 days? Seriously? I thought for sure it would be less than a month.
Yes, that's correct. Since you're only on day 25, you are well within the window for a full refund to your original payment method. No need for partial credit.
Wow, that's fantastic! I was all prepared to negotiate. Thank you, that's a huge relief.

You're very welcome, Alex. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return process and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office.
Perfect. Thanks so much for your help today, Sarah.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Nope, that's all. Have a great day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
